description: Verse answers a question: a direct answer from Verse's model, with the Wikipedia source linked when one matches. One call, one answer. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/answer.
name: paid_answer
title: Ask Verse (paid answer) (0.05 USDC, x402)
